what_this_is: No withdrawal. This document exists to carry the 020 identity ruling into the authority beside the membrane verdict it overrides, through the builder's own identity_confirmations channel.

identity_confirmations.why: the page states this row's exact street address and this row's exact telephone; the only disagreement is IHG's own naming convention, which writes 'avid hotels <city> - <metro>' where the census wrote 'avid hotel <city>'. Membrane rule M10 asks for property-code-plus-street or street-plus-owner-qualified-name and does not list street-plus-telephone, which is the gap this ruling fills
